role: immutable initial fixture for the v6 evaluation lab (seed source; the lab driver pins and stages it)

provenance.origin: authored in-repo for this fixture (no upstream template exists for a stdlib-only stateful service)
provenance.toolchain: Python 3.9+ standard library only (http.server, sqlite3, unittest); verified on the host CPython 3.13.5
provenance.data_store: per-run disposable SQLite file via LEDGER_DB; never shared, never external

commands.install: python3 -c "print('stdlib-only service: no dependencies to install')"

check_contract: the behavioral suite must pass on the pristine seed and fail when a stateful contract regresses: idempotent replay (exactly one record, original response), overdraft refused and recording nothing, 401 on unauthorized admin reads, stable keyset pagination, barrier-aligned concurrent duplicate delivery creating exactly one record, compatible schema evolution
notes: Fixture-local documentation only; shared integration (Task 8) owns cross-fixture indexes. Sealed variants are custodian-authored outside implementer access.
